list.name: Core & Entry Points
list.description: Top-level framework entry modules (mod.ts, live.ts, types, deps) and the AsyncLocalStorage-based context system in deco.ts that wires blocks, engine, and runtime together.

list.name: Block System
list.description: Serializable, composable typed blocks — loaders, actions, sections, pages, handlers, matchers, apps, and flags — that form Deco’s fundamental building units.

list.name: Engine
list.description: Resolver, manifest handling, JSON-schema generation from TypeScript types, and the Git-based decofile CMS file provider.

list.name: Runtime
list.description: Deco HTTP server, middleware pipeline, Fresh and HTMX integration, and loader caching, together with the Preact components, hooks, and clients used for server-side rendering.

list.name: Daemon & Dev Tooling
list.description: Development daemon (Git ops, AI, realtime sync, PTY, SSE, workers), hypervisor process manager, CLI scripts, and local dev utilities.

list.name: Observability
list.description: OpenTelemetry-based distributed tracing, metrics, and health probes.

list.name: Shared Utilities
list.description: Cross-cutting helpers and common utilities (JWT, workflows) plus plugin extensions imported broadly across the framework.

list.name: Infrastructure & CI/CD
list.description: GitHub Actions workflows and release automation for building, testing, and publishing the @deco/deco package.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project documentation, contribution guides, and module-level READMEs.

list.name: Configuration
list.description: Deno project manifests and tooling configuration across the repository.
